def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width / full-height separator lines define tiles.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = grid[rows[0]][0] if rows else grid[0][cols[0]]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rows + [h], [-1] + cols + [w]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        line = []
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
            from collections import Counter
            counts = Counter(v for v in vals if v != sep)
            base = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            odd = sum(n for v,n in counts.items() if v != base)
            line.append(1 if odd >= 2 else base)
        out.append(line)
    return out
